apps.localizedDescription: CloudNow is a native cloud gaming app for Apple TV. GeForce NOW and Xbox Cloud Gaming run as separate provider modes behind one tvOS interface. Each provider keeps its own account, catalog, settings, session, signaling, quality, and input behavior.
